title: Q-RULE-no-merge-over-red-mergeaudit: standing rule no-merge-over-red violated (mergeaudit)
body:
**Owner:** staff
**Trigger:** every lane pass (rules --run --due)
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation rules --probe merged-green
**Status:** closed

RULES-1: the standing rule `no-merge-over-red` is violated: A PR merges only on a green full `checks` run; a merge that skipped it is filed and fixed (MERGE-AUDIT-1, LANE-1).
Probe `mergeaudit` says: merged without green checks: #719

Fix the cause in code so the probe passes; the tick re-runs it every pass. Never weaken the probe or the registry.

**Evidence:** closing probe passed (2 consecutive passes after a recorded failure): ok: every recent merge had a green checks run


**Relapse:** 2026-11-21T16:11:43Z closing probe failed again: violated: merged without green checks: #1268, #1461, #1750 (reopen 1; closes again only after 2 passes over 60 minutes)

**Disposition:** fixed (ttl, 2026-11-21T18:12:26Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 28.4 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).

**Evidence:** 2026-11-22T05:51:22Z closing probe passed after the item was disposed: ok: every recent merge had a green checks run


**Relapse:** 2026-11-25T00:43:46Z closing probe failed again: violated: merged without green checks: #2081 (reopen 2; closes again only after 2 passes over 60 minutes)

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-25T00:43:51Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 106.9 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
